name: Rezint
description: Geldan's longtime partner, a former student of Illvoi script and former hustler, who accompanies her into Uthros and tries to talk her out of opening the doors.

description_citations.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan agrees to the job and learns the plan: wear Velmenon's sensor vests, evade sentries, find the nonexistent installation and reach the doors near the core.
timeline.quote: Find the installation there—the one that doesn't exist.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan has traded her own ship for two Monoist pressure suits and now flies an ugly old Kav mining vessel.
timeline.quote: Geldan is still raw after trading in her own ship, a saucy, nimble thing, a place built to her own tastes

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan and Rezint set out from the salvage yard, blending in with drifting ships.
timeline.quote: They start from the salvage yard near where the ship has been parked, following the stream of unmoored ships out, trying to blend in with them, directionless detritus.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Rezint proposes skirting a storm to mask them from the sentries and Geldan accepts.
timeline.quote: "I'm convinced," Geldan says.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A gust damages the plasma torches and the ship begins steering itself into the storm.
timeline.quote: a strong gust hits the ship with a violent cracking noise.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan loses control of the ship and the two ride out the storm strapped into their seats.
timeline.quote: I've lost wire and hydraulics, can't steer this anymore.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Rezint reveals that the Solidbodies gear includes modules that seem to measure the wearers, which unsettles him.
timeline.quote: I think a few of them are measuring us.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan schemes to wear the vests but then sell the data to a competitor, noting the contract did not forbid it.
timeline.quote: But there was nothing in the contract about exclusivity.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The damaged ship slips past the sentries disguised as storm debris.
timeline.quote: They make it through.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Out of the storm the ship is badly damaged but is drawing closer to the core, and Geldan sends Rezint to check the lifeboat.
timeline.quote: the crack in the screen on the right side of the cockpit could succumb to the pressure at any time

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan and Rezint put on Velmenon's monitoring gear and the Monoist suits, and Geldan feels the suit's power and the cell it represents.
timeline.quote: Until they get Solidbodies Research their data, Geldan and Rezint will never be free.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The two abandon the mining ship and launch in the lifeboat.
timeline.quote: They pile in and launch.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan and Rezint dodge the ring sentries by following a large sleek monster.
timeline.quote: They dodge another set of sentries by following on the tail of a monster.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: They land on the research base at the core, where the crushing pressure presses on Geldan despite her suit.
timeline.quote: Geldan feels pressure bear down on her like the palm of a giant hand, inexorable and grinding and cruel.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Three Illvoi on hovering chairs pass beneath the hidden pair, and one waves a tentacle without raising an alarm.
timeline.quote: Three Illvoi ride by, each perched delicately on their hovering chairs.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: An Illvoi researcher opens a wall terminal; Rezint glimpses it before the researcher leaves.
timeline.quote: an Illvoi comes out from the side passage they're about to move to and taps something in the wall.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Rising winds hurl sharp rock at their suits, forcing them to break into the tunnels for cover.
timeline.quote: It takes her a few minutes to realize that it's small pieces of rock, something sharp and very hard, hitting the metal of her suit.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan smashes a way into one of the ornate tunnels and they squeeze inside.
timeline.quote: Breaking into one of the ornate tunnels is just as satisfying as Geldan imagined it would be.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan takes the Illvoi worker's stool, and Rezint reports what he read on the terminal.
timeline.quote: casually swiping the stool left by the Illvoi worker as she does.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Rezint reports that the terminal text included words for big and for deity or ending.
timeline.quote: I saw the word for big, not that that's much help.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan and Rezint walk the tunnels toward the center, drawn on by a growing pull, and cross unopposed into the internal tunnels.
timeline.quote: At some point, they reach the boundary between the external passageways and the internal tunnels.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: They reach the unguarded doors, which look like a toxic-metal disposal unit.
timeline.quote: They round the corner, and there they are: the doors.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Rezint warns that the terminal said world-eater and urges Geldan to turn back.
timeline.quote: Whatever that is, Geldan, it's not something you can pluck out of a room and bring home for your trophy shelf.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan and Rezint argue over whether to go through the doors.
timeline.quote: We ought to respect that by trying to get back out.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan apologizes to Rezint and disconnects the Solidbodies gear, deciding to keep anything she finds for herself.
timeline.quote: She's given them everything she owes them.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: An alarm wails behind her as Rezint shouts in her headset; Geldan hopes he escapes and stays.
timeline.quote: Rezint's voice is in her headset, shouting something.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.
